name: @selis/extension
description: Selis MV3 browser extension: minimal-permission manifest, bundled-only build (SL-4.EXT.04, ADR-P0028), packaged engine under a size budget (SL-4.EXT.05). No remote code, no CDN, no eval, no broad host permissions.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node tools/pack.mjs && node dist/pkg/extension/src/bundle-check.js && node dist/pkg/extension/src/size-check.js
